fields.label: Location
fields.note: Keka jobLocations; the embed widget filters the fetched rows in the browser.

fields.label: Department
fields.note: From Keka /api/embedjobs/departments/; the portal's jobListingSetting.filters are [department, location] and are applied client-side.

fields.label: Employment type
fields.note: Keka jobType 2=Full Time, 1=Part Time; the embed bundle filters on jobTypeId in the browser.

notes: SecPod's official careers page embeds the Keka widget in #khembedjobs for identifier 8010166a-b48d-4997-9d93-64a354522150. The single listing request is GET /careers/api/embedjobs/default/active/<identifier>, which takes no keyword, filter, sort or pagination parameter; /careers/api/organization/default/careerportalinfo declares jobListingSetting.filters=[department,location] (grouped by department), and the embed bundle applies department, location, jobType and free-text search in the browser. Filters are therefore local on the collected rows.
evidence: https://secpod.keka.com/careers/api/embedjobs/globalfiltergroups/8010166a-b48d-4997-9d93-64a354522150 -> Business Unit + Department groups listed above
